notes: Paths are relative to tools/data/raw. A null path or sha256 means the file has not been downloaded and recorded yet. A layout with verified=false is refused by build_quran_db.py unless --allow-unverified is given, and such a database is marked unverified.

uthmani.name: KFGQPC Hafs, 15-line Madani
uthmani.verification_note: Line membership from QUL's Unicode 1421H layout preview (tool 27), whose words match resource 312 exactly; 15 defective preview pages patched from resource 10 (see layout.patched_pages). Owner visual acceptance is still pending.

layout.note: QUL offers no download for this Unicode layout. Pages 1–604 were saved from the public preview on 2026-10-15 and converted with tools/convert_qul_preview_layout.py. Replace with an official export when QUL provides one.

patched_pages.reason: Defective preview pages: a word omitted (276, 278, 280, 286, 425, 436, 468); an empty mid-page line beside a doubled line (480, 547); surah 94's first words attached to its heading (596); words moved between adjacent lines, giving pairs such as 6/18 words where resource 10 has 12/12 (135, 213, 244, 303, 304). Each patched page covers exactly the same first and last words. Reported to QUL.

layout.convert_command: python3 tools/convert_qul_preview_layout.py --pages tools/data/raw/uthmani/tool27-preview-2026-10-15 --words tools/data/raw/uthmani/qpc-hafs-word-by-word.db-extracted/qpc-hafs-word-by-word.db --output tools/data/raw/uthmani/kfgqpc-1421h-unicode-15-lines.db --page-count 604 --name "KFGQPC 1421H print (Unicode text), converted from QUL tool 27 preview" --patch-from tools/data/raw/uthmani/qpc-v2-15-lines.db-extracted/qpc-v2-15-lines.db --patch-pages 135,213,244,276,278,280,286,303,304,425,436,468,480,547,596
layout.rejected_alternative: Resource 10 for all pages: 1,694 of 9,001 lines differ in word membership from the Unicode layout.
